title: SignalX Zero design-system audit
description: Whether what a design system BUILT says what it claims — emitted as dist/audit.json by the zero build and by `sigx zero:audit --json` (docs/architecture.md, "The verification architecture"). Every finding is a verdict about one place, read from the compiled CSS: a declared state no part renders differently, an indicator that draws nothing, a real <button> the user agent still paints, a declared axis step a scope neither paints nor claims, an infinite animation that never stops under reduced motion. What a declared mechanism excused (skipStates, the anatomy's hiddenIn, tokens.scopes, a fill-role declaration) is listed under `waived` rather than swallowed. The summary is what report.json carries under `audit` and what the score's sixth criterion reads.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema — the emitter always writes exactly this URL.

auditVersion.description: Shape version of this document. Bumped when a consumer would have to change to keep reading it.

name.description: The design system's name, as declared on the design-system input.

findings.description: Sorted severity → rule → where, so two runs over one input diff cleanly.

waived.description: Findings a declared mechanism excused — visible, not silent.

byRule.description: Finding count per rule, for the rules that fired.

ruleId.description: The closed set of audit rules — `AUDIT_RULES` in the kit. The contrast rules (`contrast/text`, `contrast/indicator`, `contrast/unmeasured`) join when the static contrast matrix lands. report.schema.json mirrors this list under `audit.byRule`; a test pins the two against `AUDIT_RULES`.

severity.description: A property of the RULE, not of the design system: error for a lifted CI hard-fail, warning for the advisory rules, info for what is listed but never charged.

finding.description: A verdict about one place. `where` is the `ValidationIssue` spelling (`scope`, `scope.part`, `scope.axis`, or `axis.value` for a design-system-level finding); the structured fields beside it are what a tool reads.

waiver.description: A finding plus the mechanism that excused it. Mirrors `finding` property for property — 2020-12 composition with `additionalProperties: false` would otherwise need `unevaluatedProperties`.
